title: CS1 Python tasks with optional embedded ChatGPT
summary: Students complete three CS1-level Python tasks in VS Code with optional GPT-3.5 assistance and no other help resources. The research assessment captures whether they offload whole tasks, prompt step by step, verify answers, and produce correct code.

sources.title: Student-AI Interaction: A Case Study of CS1 students
sources.evidence_quote: Participants were asked to complete three programming tasks

assessment.summary: Solve three Python programming tasks in up to one hour.
student_actions: Read input-output examples and implement solutions.

outputs.artifact: Python programs and ChatGPT interaction logs

student_role.description: GPT-3.5 use was optional and unrestricted through a VS Code plugin; web search and other aids were prohibited.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: Fifteen students attempted 45 tasks; 29 of 40 completed solutions used AI and 65% of those were correct.

evidence_excerpts.quote: Participants were asked to complete three programming tasks
